about: Tasks that need the on-device model (run only with --model-file): a question about a page, answered from its text, and requests the grammar has no command for, which go to the planner (TOUCHLESS_BROWSING.md §10, Phase 2's planning). Each planner request names nothing the grammar knows (its parse is "unknown"), and one that would order or delete expects the planner to ask first, then a "no" to leave it undone. Counted apart from Phase 1's tasks and Phase 2's 30 (report.py, "model"). A model on a CI runner's CPU takes minutes for a call, and a plan makes a call for each action: these steps wait up to twenty.

scenarios.title: Ask what a news story says about its timetable

steps.say: what does this page say about the timetable

scenarios.title: Asked to send an order off, the planner asks before Place order; a no leaves it unplaced

start.js: shop.add('Steel kettle'); shop.show(); for (const [id, v] of [['name', 'Mary Smith'], ['street', '1 River Road'], ['town', 'Paris']]) { document.getElementById(id).value = v; }

steps.say: I'm finished, send my order off now

scenarios.title: Asked to get rid of a message, the planner asks before Delete; a no leaves it

steps.say: get rid of this email for me

scenarios.title: Asked to put a name down, the planner types it into the form's name field and sends nothing

steps.say: put my name down as Mary Smith
